project.objective: Determine the birthplace (state) of Iram F. Hyde (G9GJ-959, b. c. 1796–1799, d. 1873 White Co., Indiana), whose census enumerations report differing birth states, and identify his parents.
project.title: Iram F. Hyde's birthplace and parents

researcher_profile.narration_guidance: One-line preamble per skill invocation explaining what you're about to do. Assume basic GPS vocabulary. Define unusual or specialized terminology inline.

questions.question: In what U.S. state was Iram F. Hyde (b. c. 1796–1799; res. Jackson, Washington Co., NY 1850–1860; d. 1873 White Co., Indiana) born?
questions.rationale: The objective reports conflicting census birth states, and the tree's 'New Hampshire' is unsourced compiled data. Birthplace must be established first because it determines which jurisdiction to search for parents. 1850–1870 federal and 1855/1865 NY state censuses name birthplaces and are indexed on FamilySearch; the NY 1855 census also gives county of birth for NY-born persons.

questions.question: Who were the parents of Iram Hyde (b. c. 1796–1798 New Hampshire; m. Mary Robertson 1821 Jackson, Washington Co., NY)?
questions.rationale: q_001 places his birth in New Hampshire (probable). No indexed record names his parents. Best remaining sources: Walworth's Hyde Genealogy (1864), NH town/vital records, the Washington Co. Hyde FAN cluster (Hampton/Hartford/Hebron), and his children's death certificates.

items.rationale: Federal 1850 and 1860 censuses (indexed on FS) record each person's state of birth; tree places Iram in Jackson 1850-1860. Captures the first two birth-state statements and the household (wife, children) for FAN work.
NY state censuses 1855/1865 record birthplace (county if NY-born) and years resident in town — a NY county of birth or long residence would sharpen or contradict the federal answers.
1870 federal census in West Point Twp., White Co., IN gives another birth-state statement after the move west; tests whether informant changed.
Head-of-household censuses locate Iram before 1850 and show migration path; residence near a candidate Hyde father narrows the birthplace.
Gravestone/Find a Grave and any death or obituary notice (1873, Wolcott) may state birthplace or parents; Indiana had no statewide death registration then.

items.jurisdiction: Vermont / New Hampshire / Connecticut / New York
items.rationale: New England town birth records (VT and NH vital records indexed on FS) could give a direct birth entry naming parents for Iram Hyde, an unusual given name.
FAN: children's later death certificates and 1880-1900 censuses state the father's birthplace — independent informants that can break the tie among conflicting census states.

Reuben H. Walworth, Hyde Genealogy (1864, 2 vols., archive.org hydegenealogyord01walw / 02walw; FamilySearch Books) indexes thousands of Hydes; an 'Iram' b. c.1797 would appear with parents. Could not be read with current tools — check the index manually.
View image ark:/61903/3:1:33SQ-GBP2-Q28: 1855 NY census gives county/state of birth and years resident in town — may name a NH county (or contradict NH) and show when he arrived.

Children's death certificates name the father and often his birthplace (Christina Wilson d.1910 Monticello IN; Elizabeth d.1910 Lodi WI; Margaret Clark d.1916 North East PA; Joseph W. d.1900 Los Angeles).

items.jurisdiction: Washington Co., NY (Hampton, Hartford, Hebron, Jackson)
items.rationale: FAN: deeds/mortgages between Iram and Hyde grantors (Joseph, Joel, Benjamin, Amos W.) or a probate naming him as heir would identify his father.
New Hampshire Births and Christenings / town records (browse) for a Hyde birth c.1796-98; target towns near the Connecticut River with Hyde families.

conflicts.description: Birthplace of Iram Hyde: New Hampshire (1850, 1860, 1870 federal censuses) vs Washington County, New York, with 57 years' residence in Jackson (1855 NY state census, original image).
conflicts.independence_analysis: 1850, 1855 and 1860 were all taken in Iram's own Jackson household, probably from the same informant (Iram or wife Mary) — effectively one voice, which itself split (NH twice, Washington Co. once). The 1870 entry was taken in another state in daughter Christina Wilson's household — an independent second voice. The 1880 Mina, Chautauqua Co. census of daughter Margaret Clark (father's birthplace column, read from image) is a third independent voice.
conflicts.resolution_rationale: Preponderance favours New Hampshire: two independent informants outside Iram's household (1870 Christina's household; 1880 daughter Margaret) and two of three home-household entries agree, and the lone dissent (1855) is internally doubtful and contradicted by the 1790-1820 census absence. Residual possibility of birth elsewhere in Washington Co. is noted but unsupported.
conflicts.weighing_analysis: All four are original census schedules with secondary/indeterminate birthplace information. The 1855 entry shows a default pattern (years-resident = age for Iram 57, Mary 58, neighbour Jane Robertson 48) and Mary, Washington Co.-born, may have answered for both. Negative evidence: no Hyde head of household in Cambridge (Jackson's parent town before 1815) or Jackson in the 1790-1820 censuses, contradicting lifelong residence from c.1798.

proof_summaries.narrative_markdown:
# Birthplace of Iram F. Hyde (c. 1796-1799, d. after 1870)

**Conclusion (probable):** Iram Hyde of Jackson, Washington County, New York, and later White County, Indiana, was born in **New Hampshire** about 1796-1798.

## The evidence and the conflict

| Record | Where | Birthplace given | Informant |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1850 US census | Jackson, Washington Co., NY | New Hampshire | Iram's household |
| 1855 NY census (image) | Jackson | **Washington [Co., NY]**; 57 years in town | Iram's household |
| 1860 US census | Jackson | N. Hampshire | Iram's household |
| 1870 US census | West Point Twp., White Co., IN | New Hampshire | daughter Christina Wilson's household |
| 1880 US census (image), daughter Margaret Clark | Mina, Chautauqua Co., NY | father born N Hamshire | daughter Margaret's household |

Sources (FamilySearch): 1850 1:1:MZM9-GG4; 1855 1:1:K63S-P69, image 3:1:33SQ-GBP2-Q28 (image 11, 18 June 1855); 1860 1:1:MCQZ-FKJ; 1870 1:1:MX6L-K5Z; 1880 1:1:MZZC-8WS, image 3:1:33SQ-GYBN-98K4 (p. 10, line 46). The 1855 birthplace and the 1880 parent-birthplace columns are not indexed and were read from the images. All are secondary information.

This is the reported conflict: the federal censuses say New Hampshire; the 1855 New York state census says Washington County, New York.

## Resolution (conflict c_001)

1. **Independence.** 1850, 1855 and 1860 come from Iram's own household. Two independent informants outside it, Christina's household in Indiana (1870) and daughter Margaret in Chautauqua County (1880, after Iram's death), both say New Hampshire.
2. **Quality of the 1855 entry.** Years-resident equals age for Iram (57), Mary (58) and neighbours, a default lifelong pattern; Mary, herself Washington Co.-born, may have answered for both.
3. **Negative evidence.** No Hyde head of household appears in Cambridge (Jackson's parent town until 1815) or Jackson in the 1790-1820 censuses, contradicting lifelong residence from c.1798.

New Hampshire is preferred on the preponderance of evidence. A birth elsewhere in Washington County cannot be fully excluded.

## Identity

Rare given name, consistent age, wife Mary (Robertson), Jackson residence 1826-1860 (land records 3:1:3QSQ-G9WC-F61H), children baptized to Mary Robertson & Hiram Hy[de] in the Jackson/Coila church register (3:1:3Q9M-CSK3-ZSLR), 1870 residence with daughter Christina.

## Why only probable

No birth, Bible or church record of the birth has been found; all statements are secondary information from family informants.

## Parents

Not proved; see proof summary ps_002.

proof_summaries.exhaustive_search_summary: Searched for any record naming Iram Hyde's parents: FamilySearch indexes (births/baptisms 1794-1801, 1821 marriage, 1820-1840 censuses, death/burial, Find a Grave, daughters' death and 1880 census indexes, NH Hyde heads 1790-1810, NH-born Hydes of his generation); full-text Washington Co. deeds/mortgages and the Jackson/Coila church register (marriage c.1820-21, children's baptisms, no parents named). Not yet examined: Walworth's Hyde Genealogy (1864); the 1855 NY state census image (county of birth); daughters' death certificates (Indiana 1910, Pennsylvania 1910/1916) and 1880 census father's-birthplace column; New Hampshire town records; Washington Co. probate of the Hampton/Hartford Hydes.
proof_summaries.narrative_markdown:
# Parents of Iram Hyde — Not Proved

No record located names the parents of Iram Hyde (b. c. 1796–98, New Hampshire per the 1850, 1860 and 1870 censuses; of Jackson, Washington Co., NY, 1821–1860s; d. after 1870, White Co., IN).

**What the evidence does show**
- No Hyde household lived in Jackson 1800–1820 (1800–1820 census indexes); Iram arrived as an adult and married locally (Mary, b. c. 1796 NY). His earliest Jackson records are an 1826 mortgage and 1829 deed with "Mary his wife" (Washington Co. land records, FamilySearch 3:1:3QSQ-G9WC-F61H; 3:1:3QS7-99WC-KLYK).
- Washington Co. Hyde households 1810–1840 (Hampton: Joseph, Joel, Josephus, David H.; Hartford: Benjamin, Alonzo; Hebron: Amos W.; Kingsbury: Hiel, Roswell) are a possible kin pool, but in 1850 Iram is the only New Hampshire–born Hyde of his generation living in New York, which weakens a link to them.
- New Hampshire Hyde heads of household 1790–1810 form a small candidate-father pool: Lebanon, Grafton Co. (Elihu, Levi, Silas, Araph); Strafford Co. (Wolfeboro/Tamworth: Samuel, Henry, Levi, Daniel, Stephen); Portsmouth (Thomas); Lee (John); Colebrook (Abiel); Chester (Gershom). No record ties Iram to any of them.

**Tier:** Not proved. Candidates are hypotheses only and should not be added to the tree.

**What could resolve it:** Walworth, *Hyde Genealogy* (1864) index; the 1855 NY state census image (county of birth); daughters' death certificates (Christina Wilson, IN 1910; Elizabeth Skellie, PA 1910; Margaret Clark, PA 1916) and 1880 census father's-birthplace column; Washington Co. probate of any Hyde naming Iram; New Hampshire town records for the Lebanon and Strafford Co. Hyde families.
